family: Thumbnail / cover / intro visual — Family A of SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md.
primary_job: Communicate the article's thesis, tension, or framing at first glance, before the reader reads any prose.

semantic_density.rationale: Thesis-first and sparse by construction; a thumbnail is not responsible for explaining the whole article. Carrying body-infographic-level argument structure here is the documented failure mode (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §1-3; SUENGJ-VISUAL-TASTE-CALIBRATION.md §9).

visual_density.rationale: High negative space, thin quiet linework, low textual density, one dominant idea plus at most two supporting structures (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §3.2; SUENGJ-VISUAL-TASTE-CALIBRATION.md §1, §4).

text_policy.complexity_ceiling: No readable mutable text in-artwork (title, section title, date, site label, caption, citation, CTA/status/badge stay outside). Stable semantic symbols or extremely small intrinsic labels are allowed only when the concept becomes materially less legible without them (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §3.3).

composition.dominant_structure: One system tension, one transformation, one contrast, one bounded metaphor, or one large relationship between two domains (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §3.2).
composition.reading_path: Single glance; no forced sequence or reading order.

audience_adaptation.child-upper-elementary: Use a concrete, literal metaphor grounded in familiar things rather than an abstract system tension; do not rely on a symbolic encoding the reader has not been taught (audience/child-upper-elementary.json modality_effects.visual: low abstraction).
audience_adaptation.domain-expert: The bounded metaphor may reference domain-specific tension without expansion; no glossary or legend required.
audience_adaptation.beginner-learner: Prefer a metaphor with an everyday anchor point over a domain-internal one; the thumbnail should orient before any vocabulary is introduced.

renderer_preference.rule: Thumbnails usually favor a generative conceptual illustration because the job is thesis framing, not exact evidence delivery. Use deterministic rendering only when the concept itself depends on exact geometry — never force a chart/diagram renderer merely because it is easier to automate, and exact values or labels never ride on the generative layer (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §3.5).

readability_gate.rationale: The body-infographic mobile gate (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §5) does not apply here. A thumbnail instead carries a distinct small-scale legibility requirement: it must remain legible as a Home Featured image, content-card image, social/OG preview, and article intro/hero visual, and its information must survive aggressive downscaling (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §3.4).

split_rule.rationale: One plate per primary question is a body-infographic control. A thumbnail is inherently one idea and is never decomposed into plates (SUENGJ-ARTICLE-IMAGE-FAMILIES.md §6).

acceptance: a reader can state the single dominant idea within 2-5 seconds
remains legible after aggressive downscale to card/social/OG size
no baked-in mutable text (title, date, caption, citation, CTA)
does not require a legend to grasp the tension
reject: title card with baked-in article copy
decorative stock-art metaphor unrelated to the article's thesis
